title: fix(plugin-detail): a related list that already shows 0 keeps showing 0 while it reloads
body:
Fixes #36822
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化:记录页上的相关列表原本显示 0 条,重新加载(删除、筛选或其它刷新)时数量角标不再消失,一直显示 0;第一次加载还没结果时、加载失败后点重试时,仍不显示数字,不会显示假的 0。
- 为什么做:记录页加载状态的后续收尾,替上一张「加载中不显示假的 0」的卡补上刷新时角标闪没的一半。
- 出错会怎样:刷新期间角标显示上一次成功加载的数字,直到新结果到达;加载失败后数字不再显示,直到重试成功。改动只在一个组件内,可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## Responsibility
- Whose code: the platform's own `@object-ui/plugin-detail` `RelatedList`.
- Existing platform path: none; the badge has one read, `countPending`.
- Who reaches it: anyone whose related list empties on a refetch (after a delete, a filter, or a reparent).

## What changes
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`: `countPending` now also requires `!countKnown`. `countKnown` is set to true only where a read the list actually issued resolves (the record-payload seeded read, the `dataSource.find` read, the raw-URL read), and set back to false where one of those reads rejects, because the rejection empties the rows and 0 is not their count. A path that reads nothing never sets it: the no-scope early return (parent still loading, `parentId` null), a refused filter, the no-adapter refusals. Result:
  - a refetch over a list that already answered 0 keeps drawing 0 instead of blanking the badge;
  - a failed read forgets the count, so Retry's read draws no count, never a false 0;
  - a list's first real read, including one that starts only once the parent has loaded, draws nothing while in flight (the #36235 rule);
  - a list that answered rows behaves as before.
- Pins: a new top-level `describe` for #36822 in the existing badge harness `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.countPending-36235.test.tsx`.
- One `patch` changeset for `@object-ui/plugin-detail`.

## Files to read first
1. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`, the `countKnown` / `countPending` hunk: the only behaviour change.
2. The `#36822` describe in the test file: the held in-flight frame assertions (refetch, Retry, first scoped read).

## Two-minute check
`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.countPending-36235.test.tsx` — expect 7 passed.

## Tests
- `a list that answered 0 keeps drawing 0 through a refetch that answers no rows`: holds the refetch in flight and asserts the badge reads `0` on that held frame; that assertion carries the pin. A MutationObserver also samples the badge across the refetch and finds no reading other than `0`. It is a secondary signal only: it samples when its callback runs, not on each commit, so two commits inside one task would be coalesced.
- `a list that answered rows draws their count through a refetch, then the 0 it answers`: `2` during the held refetch, then `0`, nothing else in between.
- `a read that fails after rows were known draws no count while Retry reads, never a false 0`: answers 2 rows, makes the refetch reject, clicks Retry, holds Retry's read and asserts no badge, then `0` once it answers no rows.
- `a list with no scope on its first render draws no count during its first real read`: renders with `parentId` null (no read is sent), rerenders with the parent id, holds that first read and asserts no badge, then `2`.
- The #36235 pins (first read draws nothing, CONTROL empty read draws 0, compact card) stay green.

<details><summary>Readings (head 8c0243b10f)</summary>

- Pin file: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 7 passed (7)`.
- Full plugin-detail suite (`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/`): `Test Files 417 passed | 1 skipped (418)`, `Tests 3945 passed | 18 skipped (3963)`, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail run type-check`: exit 0 (the test file is in the `tsconfig.test.json` program, counted with `--listFiles`).
- Ablations with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Each mutation landed (anchor 1 to 0) and was restored to blob == HEAD (`1426a1d54928`) with `git diff HEAD` empty:
  - A1: `!countKnown` dropped from `countPending`. Result `Tests 1 failed | 6 passed (7)`: the 0-refetch pin fails on the held frame (`expected null to be '0'`).
  - A2: `setCountKnown(false)` removed from the `find` rejection. Result `Tests 1 failed | 6 passed (7)`: the Retry pin fails (`expected '0' to be null`).
  - A3: `setCountKnown(true)` added to the no-scope early return. Result `Tests 1 failed | 6 passed (7)`: the first-scoped-read pin fails (`expected '0' to be null`).
  - The N-rows pin stays green under every mutation. That is expected, since that behaviour held before the fix.
</details>

## Acceptance notes
- `countKnown` is not reset when the parent or the list's filter changes: a reparented list keeps drawing its last count during the new read, the same thing the list already did when its last answer had rows. No new behaviour beyond extending that rule to 0.
- Not changed here: while the parent record is still loading and the list has no scope yet, nothing is read, `loading` is false and the badge draws `0`. That is the same on `main` (read from the code, not measured in a browser). This PR only makes sure that phase does not mark the count known, so the first real read draws nothing.
- Browser reach was not measured; the pins mount the real `RelatedList` in jsdom with a deferred `find`.

## Verification
- Gate families derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` for this diff are run locally; CI-only families (type-check lanes, whole-tree families) are left to the PR's check-runs.
